title: KMPlayer - All Video Player
summary: 4K~8K Perfect Video Player. MPG, MKV, HEVC. It supports files of all formats.
description:
💜 KMPlayer, Customer Lounge is here!
👉 Feedback, ideas, and events—all welcome.
https://cobak.co/en/space/392

KMPlayer is a perfect media player that can play all forms of high resolution videos, music, and subtitle files.
Along with the flawless playback, enjoy the rich features of the player including quick button, bookmark, subtitle settings, and play speed settings!

🎞️ KMPlayer 🎞️
· Bookmark: Add bookmark to the time points to playback any sections you wish to cherish
· Control Color: Change brightness, light intensity, hue, saturation, and gamma information
· Expand & Contract: Expand & contract the video screen being played
· Section Repeat: Repeatedly play a section from point A to point B
· Quick button: Quickly set the player options
· Equalizer: Save separate equalizers for music & video
· Subtitle Settings: Change color, size, and position of subtitles
· Chromecast Support : Watch video on TV using Chromecast
· URL Playing: Enter URL to play any videos on the web (streaming)
· Network: Supports FTP, UPNP, SMB, WebDav
· Cloud: Supports Dropbox, OneDrive

< Supported Formats >
Video and music : AVI, MP3, WAV, AAC, MOV, MP4, WMV, RMVB, FLAC, 3GP, M4V, MKV, TS, MPG, FLV
Subtitle : DVD, DVB, SSA/ASS Subtitle Track, SubStation Alpha(.ssa/.ass) with full styling.SAMI(.smi) with ruby tag support, SubRip(.srt), MicroDVD(.sub/.txt), VobSub(.sub/.idx), SubViewer2.0(.sub), MPL2(.mpl/.txt), TMPlayer(.txt), Teletext, PJS(.pjs) , WebVTT(.vtt)

✨ KMPlayer VIP (in-app purchase) ✨
· Torrent client: Real-time play while the downloading
· Cut video & audio: Select a section of a video and audio to cut
· Create GIFs: Create lively GIFs from videos
· MP3 converter: Extract the audio in videos to MP3 files quickly and easily
· VIP themes: Create your personal unique theme from various options

< Subscription Details >
· Free trial is limited to 1 time per Google Play account.
· After the free trial period, the selected paid subscription plan will automatically be renewed and charged.
· Subscriptions canceled 24 hours prior to the end of the free trial won’t be charged.
· Subscription can be managed and canceled at any time from Google Play settings.


▶ Permission Details  ◀
< Required >
*Over Android 11
All files access: Requesting permission to access photos, music, and videos stored in the device
You can set this permission by Settings->Security and privacy->Privacy->Permission manager->Files and media->See more apps that can access all files->All files access.
(It may look different depending on the type. Search for access to all files in settings)

*Under Android 11
Storage space: Requesting permission to access photos, music, and videos stored in the device

< Optional >
Draw over other apps: Requesting permission to use pop-up play.
* You may use the basic service without agreeing to the optional permission. (However, features requiring optional permissions will not be available.)

▶ Message from the Developers ◀
KMPlayer’s development team are always open to your opinions to further improve the App. Feel free to request new features and please provide us with plentiful feedback.
Email: support.mobile@kmplayer.com
